_readme: GAME CONTENT: every PvE enemy type (source of truth). Enemies are not roster beasts: they are never owned, levelled or saved. Runtime/Encounters/EnemyCatalog builds one in-memory species (BeastRosterBuilder.ApplySpecies: SpeciesId = EnemyId, the unit's element as its only element) and one kit (SkillLibraryBuilder.ApplySkill, then every skill takes the unit's element) per (enemy, element), so enemies go through the same stat assembly as beasts. Validated by EnemyLibraryValidator (the Editor importer Beast Craft/Data/Import Encounters, the EditMode tests and Tooling/BalanceSim all run it): EnemyId lowercase snake_case, unique and never a roster SpeciesId; GrowthCurveId a beast-roster.json curve (BaseStats are max-level values scaled by it, as a beast's are; CritChance and MoveRange are exempt); MoveRange >= 1; CritChance and StatusResist 0-100; Stance a CombatStance name (missing = Vanguard); Footprint a UnitFootprint name (missing = Single; the giant is Hex7, seven tiles, which never fits a Small arena; the champion Triangle, three); at least one enemy-side SingleTarget or Line skill (the only shapes that walk a unit in), and for a Ranged enemy one with Range >= 2 (a Ranged unit never walks into melee). Skills use the skill library's SkillData shape (TargetShape, Range, Cooldown, Category, TargetingCriterion / TargetingOrder / TargetingStat, Effects, ...), in fire-priority order, with two differences: Element must be empty (every skill takes the unit's element) and SkillIds are local to the enemy. TargetingCriterion Random is refused (battles never spend the rng on enemy targeting); missing = Distance (nearest). A Damage effect's Magnitude is the skill's power, a percent of the attacking stat (DamageFormula). Threat is a hand-set estimate in 'standard enemy = 2' units that keeps a shape's generated lineups comparably hard (encounter-library.json). Every range to or from a large enemy is measured between nearest tiles, so the Hex7 giant's ranges are authored one lower than a one-tile unit's. Three skills apply statuses (behaviour bonds, see docs/design/battle-system.md, 'Team bonds'): the giant's Quake stuns, the caster's Bolt burns and the stingling's Sting poisons, so the Twilight bond has something to cleanse. The numbers came over from the balance simulator's former fixtures and are simulator-tuned, not confirmed balance. Edit here, then in Unity run Beast Craft/Data/Import Encounters; re-run the balance simulator (Tooling/BalanceSim/README.md) and regenerate encounter-difficulty.json with --write-difficulty after any change. Display text (names, descriptions, lore) is DRAFT pending producer review; tone, naming and length rules are in docs/design/content-bible.md.

Enemies.Description: A hill-sized elder of the wild, woken cross by the Gloam. It fills seven hexes, hits hard up close and at range, and every few turns stomps or roars at everything around it.

Skills.Description: A huge fist on the nearest foe.
A searing glare at the nearest foe within two hexes.
Stamps the ground, striking everything adjacent; may stun for a turn.
A bellow that batters everything adjacent.

Enemies.Description: The strongest creature of its pack, swollen with Gloam until it fills three hexes. It cleaves the front line, hexes whichever foe is weakest and sends out shockwaves.

Skills.Description: A sweeping blow on the nearest foe.
A curse on the foe with the least HP within two hexes.
A burst of force that strikes everything within two hexes.

Enemies.Description: A thick-hided, horned creature that plants itself in the way. Blows barely dent it, and it smashes whatever is nearest.

Skills.Description: A heavy blow on the nearest foe.

Enemies.Description: A lean, shadowy hunter that circles wide and pounces on whichever foe has the least HP left.

Skills.Description: A pouncing strike on the foe with the least HP.

Enemies.Description: Gloamed wild folk who keep to high ground and loose arrows from three hexes away. Frail once caught.

Skills.Description: An arrow at the nearest foe within three hexes.

Enemies.Description: A gloamed hedge-mage who hangs back and hurls spiteful bolts at the weakest foe, which may leave it burning.

Skills.Description: A bolt at the foe with the least HP within three hexes; may leave it burning for two turns.

Enemies.Description: A wild-folk elder with a gnarled staff who wades in close and calls squalls down on groups of foes.

Skills.Description: A rap of the gnarled staff on the nearest foe.
Calls a squall down on everything within two hexes.

Enemies.Description: A tiny scuttling mite that comes by the dozen. Each bite is small; the swarm is not.

Skills.Description: A small bite on the nearest foe.

Enemies.Description: A buzzing, wasp-like pest. Its sting is small but may leave a lingering poison.

Skills.Description: A sting on the nearest foe; may poison it for two turns.
